claim: The S3 File Gateway user guide says Amazon S3 File Gateway supports the S3 Standard, S3 Standard-Infrequent Access, S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access, S3 Intelligent-Tiering and Amazon Glacier storage classes.
question: Which S3 storage classes does S3 File Gateway support according to the user guide?

values.display: Amazon S3 Standard, Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access

qualifiers.scope: Amazon S3 File Gateway, user guide wording
qualifiers.condition: the guide says you pick one of the four S3 classes when creating the file share, and lifecycle moves objects to GLACIER

note: The FAQ (storage-gateway-faq-s3-file-storage-classes) lists four S3 classes and a lifecycle move to S3 Glacier; the guide names Amazon Glacier in the same list. Compatible but worded differently.
